body:
INSTAGRAM
What companies pay consultants for that you can automate, from an ex-PwC consultant.

A lot of consulting is repeat work: status reports, data pulls, slide formatting, meeting notes, first drafts.
Automate anything that follows a template. Keep the judgement calls human.
Start with your most boring recurring task: write the steps down, find the template, automate the gathering first.

What eats your week? Comment it below and I might automate it in the next episode.
Small business? DM me AUDIT.
